title: Novel combinatory method for surface and crystallinity analysis of crystalline materials
author: Matkivskyi, Røyset, et al.

steps.title: Cut wafer into pieces
steps.instruction: Laser‑cut the multi‑crystalline Si wafer into 4 × 4 cm² pieces.

steps.title: RCA‑1 cleaning
steps.instruction: Clean the cut pieces in RCA‑1 solution at 65–70 °C, then rinse and dry.

steps.title: First wet polishing
steps.instruction: Prepare polishing Solution 1 (by weight): HF (49 %) < 10 %, KOH < 6 %, DI water 71 %; immerse the wafer pieces in this solution for the prescribed polishing time, then rinse and dry.

steps.title: Second wet polishing
steps.instruction: Prepare polishing Solution 2 (by weight): HNO₃ (75 %) 50 %, NaOCl < 2 %, NH₄OH 14 %, CH₃COOH 40 %, IPA < 5 %, H₂O₂ 14 %, DI water 80 %; immerse the wafer pieces in this solution for the prescribed polishing time, then rinse and dry.

description: The two tools described above were combined to determine the etching response of individual crystals in multi-crystalline Si wafers to different etching solutions. The method consisted of the main experimental steps: wafer polishing, Laue tool scanning, WLI scanning, wet chemical etching, second round WLI scanning as illustrated in Fig. 3.
